job.title: Senior Analyst, Risk Management
job.description:
• Manage key projects to build and uplift risk management approaches.
  • Evolving business, fun and inclusive workplace. Excellent career prospects
  • Sydney or Melbourne based. Permanent role. Competitive salary + bonus and benefits.
Role

Work closely with the leadership team to build and implement industry leading Risk Management frameworks, risk programs and controls. You will also be responsible for advising across regulatory engagement strategies, regulatory change and prudential compliance programs.

As a key member of the team you will contribute to, and drive project outcomes including client and stakeholder management, in collaboration with the leadership team.

Overall, you will play a crucial role in driving effective risk management and promoting a proactive approach to risk and compliance within a wide variety of top tier organisations.

Benefits
  • Opportunity to up skill yourself across cutting-edge topics such as CPS230, Cyber risk, Generative AI & privacy – lots of ongoing work here for many years to come.
  • Strong employee-focused culture with excellent work life balance.
  • This company is redefining what true partnership with clients means = excellent job satisfaction
  • Fun and inclusive workplace with regular social events. Diversity is their strength.
  • Your career is their priority, the opportunities you’ll receive aren’t restricted by title/level
  • Be mentally stimulated being part of building something innovative.
Skills and Experience

To be successful in this firm, you will bring a blend of 2-4 + years of technical skills across Risk, Compliance or Audit, ideally from Professional Services (any industry sector considered).

Perhaps more importantly though you will be the type of person who likes to push the boundaries in your work. You will enjoy a fast paced, evolving environment where you can use your analytical abilities to problem solve clients issues and enhance risk and compliance strategies.

You will need excellent written and verbal communication skills with an attention to detail and always be striving for the best.
  
How to Apply

If you are considering a change and want to work for an industry leader and true innovator in its sector, we want to hear from you. Apply now by submitting your CV for immediate consideration!

For a confidential chat, contact Jen Jones at Ink Recruitment on +61 (0)409 926 897 or send over your CV to hello@inkrecruitment.com.au

job.title: Risk and Compliance Analyst
job.description:
This is a genuinely hands-on role for someone who wants real breadth in their risk role, spanning incident management, board-level reporting and ownership of a core risk system.

Join a close-knit Risk and Compliance team at a well-regarded insurance provider that's actively investing in growing the function.
  • Hands-on Risk and Compliance Analyst role with genuine variety across incident management, reporting and Protecht system ownership
  • Growing risk function backed by strong executive and board support, with a genuine pathway to progress
  • $100k + Super | Hybrid role, 2 days in the office (Thursdays are a must)
The Role

Reporting diretly to the CRO, you'll act as a support function for the broader team while driving several initiatives in your own right. It's a role that rewards someone with sharp attention to detail and the lateral thinking to understand not just how a risk framework is designed, but how it actually plays out day to day. The business is putting more resource behind risk and compliance, so there's a clear runway here for someone who wants to build on this role over time.

Key Responsibilities
  • Protecht administration sits with you, from managing day-to-day system changes to delivering training and support across the business
  • Incident coordination is a core part of the role, triaging incidents as they're logged, assessing severity, assigning ownership and guiding issues through to closure
  • Reporting and insights you'll own, including weekly incident reports, Power BI reporting built alongside the data analytics team, and quarterly Non-Financial Risk reporting for the risk committee and board
  • Controls assurance and reviews round out the role, giving you extra exposure to additional assurance work and ad hoc reviews as they come up
Desired Experience
  • 3+ years' experience in a risk, compliance or controls-related role, ideally within financial services or another regulated industry
  • Genuine hands-on experience with Protecht or a similar Enterprise Risk Management system
  • A background in incident management, root cause analysis or controls assurance, with the analytical rigour to properly unpack detail
  • Confidence preparing reporting and insights for senior stakeholders and committees
  • Tertiary qualification in a business-related discipline; risk management accreditation is a plus
  • A critical, lateral thinker who's driven rather than simply capable, and who can see the bigger picture behind the process
Benefits
  • Genuine and well-supported pathway to grow within an expanding risk function
  • Hybrid working, 2 days per week in the office (Thursdays essential)
  • A small, tight-knit team environment backed by real executive investment in risk maturity
  • Broad exposure across systems, incident management, reporting and assurance, ideal for someone wanting to round out their risk and compliance skill set early
How to Apply

For a confidential chat, contact Jen Jones at Ink Recruitment on +61 (0)409 926 897.

job.title: Governance Specialist / Board Administrator
job.description:
A leading superannuation fund is seeking an experienced Governance Specialist to join its governance division on an immediate-start contract. In this role, you will work closely with the Company Secretary and Senior Manager, providing full secretariat and governance support to the Board and its Management Committees.

This is a hands-on position managing highly confidential information, engage with senior stakeholders across the organisation, and help keep the fund's governance framework running smoothly under tight timelines.

Responsibilities
  • Deliver end-to-end secretariat services, including minute taking, action registers, agendas, papers, attendance and quorum checks, and meeting conduct.
  • Review Board and Committee papers, offering thoughtful advice on content and resolutions to support informed decision-making.
  • Support the review of governance policies to ensure they meet regulatory, legislative, and industry best-practice standards.
  • Maintain Board and Committee skill matrices, and assist with annual and triennial performance reviews for the Board, Committees, and Directors.
  • Ensure the governance and statutory information published on the fund's website remains accurate and current.
  • Contribute to the Annual Integrated Report from a governance perspective.
  • Coordinate the annual response to the AIST Governance Code.
  • Provide back-up support to the wider governance team and assist on major projects as needed.
Experience
  • A background in superannuation and/or corporate governance.
  • Proven ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion.
  • Confidence managing senior stakeholders and competing priorities under pressure.
  • Strong attention to detail and a track record of meeting tight deadlines.
  • Excellent written communication, particularly in minute taking and paper preparation.
Beyond a competitive daily rate, this contract offers a clear pathway to a permanent role for the right person, along with the chance to work at the heart of a major fund's decision-making.

Apply now! For a confidential chat, contact Karen Thorne at Ink Recruitment on +61 (0)420 788873 or send your resume on word to karen.thorne@inkrecruitment.com.au
